card.name: Opioid warning phrases: management of pain
card.fires_on: The word "of" in "proper management of pain" in the opioid addiction-risk warning. It also fires weakly on "all" in "monitor all patients" and on "in" or "is" in nearby warning sentences.

modes.label: Management of pain
modes.description: The linking word "of" (or "in") inside the stock sentence saying risks should not prevent proper pain management.
modes.example: The potential for these risks should not, however, prevent the proper management<< of>> pain in any given patient.

modes.label: Monitor all patients
modes.description: The word "all" after "monitor" in opioid prescribing warnings.
